description: Ask the merchant to undo a publish (put back what it replaced, or remove an item it created). This does not undo by itself: the merchant clicks Undo on the card or on the link this returns.

store.description: Which connected store (its myshopify address, e.g. other-store.myshopify.com). Leave it out for the default store; list_stores shows them.

name: request_undo
title: Ask the merchant to undo
